spans.s:
यंतृ a [यम्-तृच्]
1 Restraining,
curbing, controlling.
--2 Guiding,
directing. --m.
1 A director,
governor, ruler.
--2 A driver (as of
an elephant, carriage &c.); coachman,
charioteer; यंता गजस्याभ्यपतद्गजस्थं

; अथ यंतारमादिश्य धुर्यान्
विश्रामयेति सः 1. 54.
--3 An
elephantdriver or rider.

.
--2
To bind, fasten.
--3 To force, oblige,
compel.

यंत्रं [यंत्र्-अच्]
1 That which
restrains or fastens, any prop or
support, a stay; as in गृहयंत्र (see the
quotation under this word).
--2 A
fetter, band, fastening, tie, thong.
--3 A surgical instrument, especially
a blunt instrument (opp. शस्त्र).
--4
Any instrument or machine, an
appliance, a contrivance, implement in
general; कूपयंत्र

‘a
machine for drawing up water from a
well’; so तैल˚, जल˚ &c.
--5 A
bolt, lock.
--6 Restraint, force.
--7 An
amulet, a mystical or astronomical
diagram used as an amulet.
--Comp.
--आलयः a printing-press.
--उपलः
a mill, mill-stone.
--करंडिका a
kind of magical basket.
--कर्मकृत्
m. an artist, artisan.
--गृहं {1} an
oil-mill. {2} a manufactory.
--गोलः
a kind of pea.
--चेष्टितं any magical
work, an enchantment.
--तक्षन् m.
{1} a constructor of machines. {2} a
[]
preparer of charms.
--तोरणं a
mechanical arch (fitted with
contrivances to move it).
--दृढ a. secured
by a bolt (as a door).
--नालं a
mechanical pipe or tube.
--पुत्रकः,
--पुत्रिका a mechanical doll, a puppet
furnished with contrivances, such as
strings, for moving the limbs.
--पेषणी a hand-mill.
--प्रवाहः an
artificial stream of water;

.
--मार्गः a canal or an aqueduct.
--शरः
an arrow or any missile shot off by
means of machinery.

यंत्रकः [यंत्र्-ण्वुल्]
1 One well
acquainted with machinery.
--2 A
mechanist.
--3 A restrainer, controller,
subduer.
--कं
1 A bandage (in
medic.).
--2 A turner's wheel or
lathe.

यंत्रणं --णा [यंत्र्-ल्युट् वा टाप्]
1
Rest raining, curbing, stopping;
करयंत्रण दंतुरांतरे व्यलिखच्चंचुपुटेन पक्षती

.
--3
Fastening, binding (बंध);
निबिडपीनकुचद्वय यंत्रणा तमपराधमधात् प्रतिबध्नती

.
--4 Force, compulsion,
constraint, trouble, pain or anguish
(arising from compulsion);
अलमलमुपचारयंत्रणया

यंत्रणं --णा [यंत्र्-ल्युट् वा टाप्]
1
Rest raining, curbing, stopping;
करयंत्रण दंतुरांतरे व्यलिखच्चंचुपुटेन पक्षती

.
--3
Fastening, binding (बंध);
निबिडपीनकुचद्वय यंत्रणा तमपराधमधात् प्रतिबध्नती

.
--4 Force, compulsion,
constraint, trouble, pain or anguish
(arising from compulsion);
अलमलमुपचारयंत्रणया

यंत्रणी, यंत्रिणी A wife's younger
sister.

यंत्रणी, यंत्रिणी A wife's younger
sister.

यंत्रित p. p. [यंत्र्-क्त]
1 Restrained,
checked, curbed, controlled,
confined.
--2 Fastened, bound.
--3
Fettered, chained.
--4 Subject to.
--Comp.
--कथ, --वाच् a. ‘tongue-tied’,
forced to be silent.

यंत्रिन् a. or s.
1 Furnished with
harness or trappings (as a horse).
--2 One who pains, a tormentor.
--3
One who possesses an amulet.

यानं [या-भावे ल्युट्]
1 Going,
moving, walking, riding; as गजयानं,
उष्ट्र˚, रथ˚ &c.
--2 A voyage, journey;
स मुद्रयानकुशलाः

.
--3 Marching against, attacking
(one of the six Guṇas or expedients
in politics); अहितान्प्रत्यभीतस्य रणे
यानं Ak.;

.
--4 A
procession, train.
--5 A conveyance,
[]
vehicle, carriage, chariot; यानं सस्मार
कौबेरं

.
--6 A litter, palanquin.
--नः Ved. A road, way.
--Comp.
--करः a carpenter.
--पात्रं a ship,
boat.
--भंगः shipwreck.
--मुखं the
forepart of a carriage, the part where
the yoke is fixed.
--यानं driving or
riding in a carriage.
--शाला a
coachhouse.

यांत्रिक a. (की f.)
1 Belonging
to machines, mechanical.
--2
Artificially refined.
